title: Memorizing Easy Guitar Songs: Focus on Repetitive Chord Progressions (4-5 Song Repertoire)
summary: In this 2020 JustinGuitar video, the host presents a practical method for memorizing simple songs on guitar suitable for social settings. He emphasizes choosing tunes you enjoy that use very small numbers of chords and learning the chord order so you can perform from memory without a songbook or searching online. The approach centers on repetitive chord progressions, avoiding songs with varied verse/chorus patterns, and building a short repertoire—about four to five easy songs—that you can recall reliably at parties. The guidance also recommends delaying the inclusion of more complex pieces until you’ve established a solid recall baseline and feel comfortable with the simpler material.
